short_description: Sono Motors is a Munich-headquartered German electric-mobility company founded in 2016 by Laurin Hahn, Jona Christians and Navina Pernsteiner that focuses on solar-integrated electric-vehicle technology. Its flagship consumer programme, the solar-integrated Sion passenger car, was wound down in early 2023 as the company refocused on business-to-business solar integration for third-party vehicles. Sono Group N.V., the company's parent listed on the Nasdaq stock exchange since November 2021, was delisted in 2024.
